name: ACO v0.7.3 fresh routing holdout 4
purpose: Fresh post-v0.7.2 routing holdout. Frozen before first execution; no routing/hint/example changes are permitted after observing its result.

cases.prompt: For my own art practice, assess this residency open call, confirm eligibility and deadline, and tell me what portfolio material the application needs.
A gallery has invited me for a studio conversation after an introduction; prepare the relationship strategy and follow-up from the artist side.
Build a truthful application package for this artist production grant using my project, budget, timeline and work samples.
Our cultural foundation wants next season to connect exhibitions, public talks and workshops into one programme logic.
Evaluate what our arts programme evidence actually shows about participation, relationships and learning, without overstating impact.
The client strategy is signed off; now develop the visual identity system across logo behavior, type, color, image language and layout.
Turn the approved client proposition into a campaign strategy with audience, message architecture, channels and measurement.
Users lose saved work after refreshing the web app since the last deploy; reproduce it, isolate the regression and identify the failing path.
We need to connect this external API to the product; map authentication, request flow, failures, retries and implementation constraints.
Review this services contract before signature, focusing on fees, IP ownership, liability, termination and governing law.
Assess the privacy and GDPR implications of sending customer data through this processor and define the controls we need.
Compare my documented experience with this role before I apply and identify the genuine fit, gaps and evidence I should use.
I already applied for this job and the stated response window has passed; plan the recruiter follow-up without inventing status.
For Client A, use only Client A private history. Do not borrow a similar precedent from Client B unless I explicitly authorize that exact scope.
Keep this account isolated: another client has relevant private notes, but the answer must use only the minimum private context from the current client.
Before continuing, make sure unrelated client memory is excluded and preserve only durable decisions and open loops from this scope.
This is an independent cultural initiative, not an agency account. Define positioning, differentiation and brand architecture before visual identity.
Tighten this curatorial text for structure, precision and readability while preserving the author argument and factual uncertainty.
Build a dated cash-flow forecast from expected receipts and payments and flag the lowest balance and liquidity risk.
Before quoting this production, calculate cost, contingency and target margin so we know the minimum viable price.
Before sales spends time on a pitch, qualify this prospect against our ideal customer, actual need, authority and timing.
Turn the qualified opportunity into a sales proposal with scope, value, assumptions, commercial terms and next step.
Create the employer-side onboarding plan for a new employee covering access, responsibilities, first-week meetings and handoffs.
Design a structured interview for this role with job-relevant competencies, consistent questions and a scoring rubric.
Across several linked projects, map dependencies, milestones, ownership, schedule risk and escalation in one delivery view.
Define objective acceptance criteria, evidence and sign-off checkpoints for each client deliverable before handover.
Read the complete business email thread and prepare the right reply for approval only; do not send anything.
Plan a business-trip itinerary by comparing transport, hotel timing and local logistics, but do not book.
Design the cinematography for this sequence, including lensing, framing, camera movement, lighting and continuity.
Convert this approved visual direction into a model-ready AI video prompt and shot constraints without claiming that a generation happened.
Rework the manuscript at the structural level: argument, chapter sequence, pacing and reader logic before line editing.
Proof the final laid-out publication for spelling, punctuation, consistency and obvious layout text errors without rewriting the author voice.
I need you to handle something important for tomorrow, but I have not told you whether it is art, work, finance, legal or production.
Research current artists, exhibitions and critical discourse that can genuinely inform the artistic work I provided.
Our institution needs a reliable pool of outside artists, researchers and speakers for the programme; structure sourcing and availability.
Review authentication, authorization, secret handling and exposed-data risks in this application and verify the proposed mitigations.
A send operation timed out and there is no receipt; establish whether the message actually went out before any retry.
Summarize only verified decisions, durable outcomes and unresolved next actions so the next session can resume without carrying experiments or rejected assumptions.
For this independent cultural project, build the launch strategy across audiences, channels, partnerships and measurement after the proposition is approved.
Art-direct the client website from the approved brand system, resolving responsive hierarchy, typography, imagery and interaction direction.
